cause: Bounded residual-versus-predictor figure evidence existed at the node context layer but was not exposed through the Global Agent's project-scoped read-only tool registry.
impact: The Global Agent correctly refused to invent a graph interpretation, but could not answer a user request for persisted predictor-residual bin facts after a successful Notebook workflow.
